flaws: Mechanical/Trajectory: There are sharp, jerky loops and kinks in the flight path immediately prior to entering each gate (most prominent before Gate 3 in the top and overview cameras). Instead of decelerating to a halt and turning abruptly at pre-gate waypoints, use a continuous spline trajectory or blended lookahead pursuit so the quadcopter flows smoothly through the gates.

Mechanical/Trajectory: In the low camera view, the path after Gate 3 bows out toward the right edge of the gate frame, and the final descent over the landing pad has a noticeable horizontal kink before dropping vertically. Smooth out the post-gate transition into a clean, continuous descent arc.

Visual/UI: In the chase camera view, the top-left HUD info card overlaps and obscures Gate 3 and the 'GATE 3' 3D label. Adjust the chase camera framing or offset the target center to the right so the 3D scene does not collide with the 2D UI overlay.

Visual/3D Labels: In the low camera view, the 'GATE 1', 'GATE 2', and 'GATE 3' floating labels overlap and crowd each other, while 'LAND' clips directly into the quadcopter's rotors in the chase view. Add depth-based scaling/fading or position the labels cleanly on the gate frames and pad surfaces.
parsed.summary: Achieving 16/16 validation passes with a 0.024 m landing error in 17.02 s is a solid engineering milestone, and the clean architectural aesthetic works well. However, the trajectory exhibits sharp kinks and hesitation loops right before each gate entry rather than flying a smooth continuous curve, and the camera framing causes 3D labels and gates to collide with the UI and the drone mesh.
